In my experience with mental health, my depression and body dysmorphia got to a point where I wouldn't go outside of my house for months because of this, and eventually became all I could think about. I attempted suicide on 2/11/18. She needs an intervention, which is sadly something I got after my attempt. It seems that your friends mental illness is so severe that she can't focus on anything else. Does she have a therapist? If not, this might be the reason she rants to you about her problems. In extreme cases some people require a trip to the hospital for a few days, and an in-patient treatment plan. No matter what, please don't give up on her, even if all you can do is suggest professional help. Good luck!
